text: Developing a mobile app requires careful planning. One of the first decisions is choosing between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for a specific system, like iOS or Android, offering the best performance and access to all device features. Cross-platform tools allow you to write one codebase that works on both, saving time and money, though they may sacrifice some speed. Regardless of your choice, responsive design is crucial. Your app must look and work well on various screen sizes and orientations. Finally, you will need to publish your finished product on app stores like the Apple App Store or Google Play. These platforms have strict guidelines, and approval is essential for reaching users. Ultimately, a smooth, fast, and well-designed app is key to user satisfaction.
